listitem.para: Whether ipsec add --autoall (run by &pluto; at startup, and by hand to apply an edited ipsec.conf) should reconcile the running connections with the configuration instead of only adding to them. When enabled, an unchanged connection is left in place, keeping its established SAs, and any connection that --autoall does not load is deleted, including connections skipped because of auto=ignore and connections added by other means.

A connection last added other than by a reconciling --autoall, for instance before this option was enabled, is re-added once. A later ipsec add --autoall takes over from one still running. To see what would change, use ipsec add --autoall --dry-run (see &ipsec-add.8;).
